test_name: Verify Navigation to 'Store' Page from Empty Cart
description: Tests the functionality of the 'Return to Shop' button on the cart page to ensure users can navigate back to the store page successfully.
steps: Locate the 'Return to Shop' button using its stable selector.
Verify that the button is enabled and visible on the page.
Click on the 'Return to Shop' button.
Wait for the page to load completely.
Verify that the user is redirected to https://atid.store/store/.
Check that the store page displays product categories and listings.
expected_results: User is redirected to the store page.
Store page displays product categories and listings without errors.
edge_cases: Button is disabled or not visible.
Button click does not redirect to the store page.
Store page fails to load or loads partially.
Button redirects to an incorrect page.
data_requirements: Accessible 'Return to Shop' button on the cart page.
Browser compatibility for the cart page.
dependencies: User must have no items in the cart.
api_interactions: None, as this is purely a UI navigation test.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the store page after navigation.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Return to Shop' button is keyboard accessible.
Verify ARIA roles and labels for the button.
Check color contrast for the button text against its background.
